description: Bounded ChatGPT Web Planner -> authorized DSH Agent executor -> independent ChatGPT Web Reviewer loop; context is read through connected GitHub/Remote Desktop Commander apps and correlated execution evidence, not mandatory project ZIP or attachment uploads. Human-mediated handoff is acceptable for the first live M2 acceptance; automated app orchestration is not assumed.

userStories.title: Acquire scoped project context through connected tools
userStories.description: Planner uses GitHub for the observed remote branch/commit and Remote Desktop Commander for necessary unpushed local state, with source/provenance recorded. Codex/DSH reports are supplementary evidence. No project ZIP transport is required.
acceptanceCriteria: Planner records relevant repository, branch, observed commit and/or authorized local context source, including uncertainty.
Only task-relevant files or state are read; Planner and Reviewer do not write project files as part of routine loop.
No project ZIP generation, ZIP upload, or mandatory attachment round-trip is required.

userStories.title: Validate the bounded workflow and human/DSH approvals
userStories.description: Controller validates the structured Planner task, trusted target, workflow approval, execution trace and Reviewer decision; DSH tool permission approvals remain separate. Current state names are migration inputs, not proof of new-loop implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Unapproved tasks do not reach the DSH executor; invalid outputs and transitions fail closed.
DSH native tool rejection is not bypassed by a local shell fallback or a ChatGPT connected-app write.
Unresolved NEEDS_REPLAN/NEEDS_FIX reauthorization policy is explicitly resolved before enabling automatic affected paths.

userStories.title: Execute development only through the configured DSH Agent
userStories.description: DSH Agent remains the routine executor using openai-codex / gpt-6-luna with host-chosen workspace-write and native approval: ask defaults. Evidence captures real native tool outcomes and test results.
acceptanceCriteria: Execution and tests use DSH Agent/tools in the trusted project root; task text cannot raise permission presets or replace projectRoot.
Native approval: ask and workspace-write are default boundaries; rejection and unavailable approvals fail closed.
No automatic product-repository commit, push, reset or clean occurs.

userStories.title: Exchange plans and execution evidence without legacy ZIP transport
userStories.description: ChatGPT Web Planner and Reviewer may inspect code directly via connected GitHub/Remote Desktop Commander apps and review correlated execution records. For M2, a human-mediated Web↔Controller/DSH handoff is allowed; Bridge app-invocation capability is unverified.
acceptanceCriteria: The handoff records run, task, scope, authorization and source identity without assuming DSH Bridge can call ChatGPT apps.
Reviewer checks relevant code, Git delta, DSH/Codex report and real test evidence before a structured decision.
No attachment-upload completion, DOM.setFileInputFiles requirement, or mandatory project ZIP is in the active acceptance path.

userStories.title: Demonstrate a bounded real, evidence-driven M2 loop
userStories.description: Perform one separately authorized live human-in-the-loop Planner -> approval -> DSH Agent -> Reviewer execution, with independently verified actual file and test outcomes; retain deterministic offline tests for regression.
acceptanceCriteria: One real approved run correlates Planner proposal, approval, DSH Agent session/tool evidence, Git baseline/delta, observed test command/result and Reviewer decision.
A successful M2 demo shows expected actual changes and passing scoped tests, validated ACCEPTED review and COMPLETE state; model report alone is insufficient.
No default production-account/paid smoke is run as part of deterministic regression tests; legacy ZIP/CDP tests do not count as new-loop acceptance.
